title: Introduce compositional prompt stress prober and CI adapter
author: Maya Hernandez
release_notes: Adds a lightweight compositional stress prober plus a CI adapter that flags compositional regressions (soft-fail with triage). Includes docs and a smoke suite for prompt-set coverage.
description:
Context and motivation: We observed subtle regressions in scenarios where prompts compose multiple abstractions (e.g., nested template substitution, chained instructions, and role-switching). Existing prompt-set checks focus on surface metrics (accuracy, token-level delta) and miss compositional failure modes that only surface under suffix perturbations and multi-shot ordering changes. This PR introduces a compositional stress prober and a CI adapter to (1) systematically generate targeted perturbations, (2) score compositional fidelity, and (3) surface risky regressions to triage workflows.

What this change includes: implemented a new prober that synthesizes perturbations across three axes (suffix permutations, instruction chaining, and placeholder composition), a scoring function based on structural match + semantic similarity, a small smoke-suite of representative prompt-sets, and a CI adapter that integrates with the existing eval-gate architecture to raise a non-blocking 'compositional-risk' alert. Also added docs and a migration guide for teams who want to opt in.

Behavior and gating policy: By default the CI adapter emits a soft-fail (annotation + Slack/Linear notification) so teams are alerted without blocking merges. Projects can opt-in to a hard-fail by configuring a risk-threshold in eval-config. The adapter supports backfill runs and stores score deltas in the existing eval snapshots for longitudinal tracking.

Performance and cost: The prober is tuned to run as a low-cost smoke pass (sampled perturbations, capped shots, and early-exit rules). Empirically the added latency for the CI smoke step is ~14s on our dedicated smoke runners and cost is ~0.6% of standard eval budget in our sample workloads.

Backfill and rollout plan: Initial rollout is behind a feature flag. We'll run a 2-week backfill across high-priority prompt sets (ENG-4219 target list) to collect baselines and calibrate thresholds. After backfill we'll enable soft-fail by default and provide guidance for converting to hard gates.

Checklist: - [x] Prober implementation and unit tests - [x] CI adapter + integration tests - [x] Docs and examples - [x] Backfill harness and metrics collection - [x] Config knobs for opt-in/hard-fail

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the scoring heuristic conservative to reduce false positives. Follow-up work (ENG-4320) will add a learned calibrated regressor for risk scoring if teams opt into labeled regression data.
